headline: Choose the plan that fits you
subhead: Watch series and films on all your devices. Cancel any time.

legalText.text: The 30-day free trial applies to new customers only. A paid subscription starts when the trial ends.
You can cancel at any time. Consumers have the right to withdraw from the contract within 14 days.

faq.question: How do I cancel?
faq.answer: You can cancel in your account settings at any time.

faq.question: Which payment methods can I use?
faq.answer: You can pay by card on our payment partner's secure page.
